title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle vendoring + rke2 Ubuntu 22.04 Helm chart updates
author: Ava Chen
release_notes:
- Add vendored Helm charts for Ubuntu 22.04 RKE2 bundles
- Update offline bundle generator to include apt-mirror metadata and preseeded TUF metadata
- Rollback tooling improvements for safe bundle swaps in air-gapped installs
description: Motivation: Customers deploying Redwood Private in air-gapped environments on Ubuntu 22.04 with RKE2 reported Helm chart mismatches and missing vendored dependencies in the offline bundle. This PR vendors updated Helm charts, augments the offline bundle generator to include apt-mirror metadata and TUF preseed files, and adds a tested rollback path that swaps bundles with minimal downtime. The description includes changes made, testing done, and a rollback plan. Changes: 1) Added vendored helm charts (redwood, rke2-operator, external-dns) under vendor/helm/ubuntu-22.04; 2) Offline bundle generator: include apt mirror index and TUF preseed files so air-gapped installer can validate package integrity without internet; 3) Helm chart fixes: templating fix for nodeSelector on rke2 nodes, tolerations default, and values schema bump; 4) Added a new CLI flag --bundle-swap for the installer that performs an atomic bundle swap and rotates a symlink to enable fast rollback; 5) Integration tests and upgrade/rollback e2e harness updates. Checklist: - [x] Vendor charts and container images - [x] Update bundle generation pipeline - [x] Add integration tests for bundle swap - [x] CI green - [x] Docs updated (offline bundle README) Testing: ran full offline bundle generation in CI and locally on a test RKE2 cluster running Ubuntu 22.04 (arm64 and amd64), exercised bundle-swap and verified service continuity and certificate validity, ran helm lint and chart testing, validated TUF verification during install using a simulated mirror. Rollback plan: the --bundle-swap creates timestamped bundle directories and an atomic symlink swap; rollback is performed by swapping symlink back to previous bundle and restarting control plane pods. DB migrations are guarded by a preflight check; no irreversible DB changes in this release. Related: ENG-1245 tracks vendor automation, SUP-4571 is the customer support ticket that motivated the change.
commits: initial: vendor helm charts and add generator hooks; ci: integrate apt-mirror metadata generation; fix: templating for rke2 nodeSelector and tolerations; feat: add --bundle-swap CLI support and docs; test: add e2e bundle-swap scenarios; chore: bump chart versions and update changelogs
review_comments: Diego Ruiz: Left a comment on generator.go: please add a timeout to the apt index fetch routine and fallback to cached index in CI to avoid flakes. Also add unit tests for the new index parser.
Ava Chen: Addressed in commit 'ci: integrate apt-mirror metadata generation'—added timeout and unit tests; updated PR description with CI notes.
Priya Nair: Approve with one nit — templating change looks good but please add a short note in the chart's README about nodeSelector behavior change.
Marcus Li: Verified rollback e2e logs and approved after a minor test flake was fixed. Recommended squashing the vendor commits into a single vendoring commit for cleaner history.
ci_checks_summary: CI pipeline triggered: offline-bundle generation (passed), helm lint (passed), unit tests (passed), integration e2e (passed after one rerun), security scan (passed), image-scan (passed). One transient e2e flake retried and passed.
